$comment: XP, levels and affinity, GAME_DESIGN.md section 5. Progression.ts contains no literals.
$comment_xp: xpToNext(level) = xpBase * level^xpExponent. Strictly increasing, and level 50 is reachable, both asserted in tests.
$comment_award: 18 * defeatedLevel, times a bonus when the winner had type advantage. Party members who did not fight get partyShare of the active pal's award, so a benched pal falls behind but never stalls.
$comment_stat: stat = floor(base * (1 + level * levelStatGain) * variance). Variance is rolled once at spawn and locked for life.
$comment_affinity: 0 to 100. Above high it grants a damage bonus; below low the pal occasionally hesitates on a power attack. This is the emotional cost of the five-slot rule, so the numbers are deliberately slow to climb and fast to fall.
$comment_revive: A fainted pal is not lost. It wakes at a campfire in reviveAtCampfireMs, or on its own after reviveAloneMs of real time.
